task.title: Connect SkillSystem with PostgreSQL: 1) Load skills from skills table on startup, 2) Save new skills to PostgreSQL, 3) Enable skill versioning, categories, tags, 4) Project-specific skills via project_id, 5) Skill search via pgvector. Skills should be persistent and queryable, not just in-memory.
